name: Ridge Map
author: PointillViz authors
description: A tissue section as a relief of ridges, their height a gene or the cell density, their colour the most common cell type.

params.name: gene
params.label: Gene
params.help:
Selects the gene whose local expression sets the height of the ridges.
With no gene chosen, the height is the local cell density.

params.name: strips
params.label: Strips
params.help:
Sets how many horizontal strips the section is cut into, one ridge each.
More strips draw finer detail; fewer draw a bolder figure.

params.name: relief
params.label: Relief
params.help:
Sets how tall the tallest ridge stands, in strip heights.
Taller ridges make a more dramatic landscape and hide more of what stands behind them.

params.name: smoothing
params.label: Smoothing
params.help:
Sets the width of the neighbourhood each height and colour is measured in, the σ of a Gaussian, in strip heights.
Larger values draw calmer ridges and longer stretches of one colour.
